Synthetic Systems Engineer
Certification exam guide as of June 1, 2026
Section 1: Design systems (~50.5% of the exam)
1.1 Evaluate a synthetic system. Considerations include:
 ● Compare synthetic modes
   over a wrapped line
 ○ Match a synthetic nested requirement
 ● Select a synthetic deployment
Section 2: Operate systems (~50.5% of the exam)
2.1 Monitor a synthetic service. Considerations include:
 ● Test synthetic monitoring
2.2 Review a synthetic incident
The following tools are in scope for this exam:
 - Synthetic CLI
 - Synthetic Database
